rule: A gate is complete only when every required external and local proof is attached and independently reviewable.

gates.title: Repository, protected branch, review and CI
remaining: Create the hosted repository and first reviewed commit
Protect the production branch and require CI/review
Record a successful hosted CI run including container and Rust audits

gates.title: Separated environments and managed secrets
remaining: Provision distinct staging resources
Attach the complete staging managed-secret inventory without exposing secret values
Verify clients and developer machines contain no production credentials

gates.title: OpenID identity and authorization
remaining: Verify GitHub invitation acceptance, MFA recovery, logout and revocation in staging

gates.title: Supabase PostgreSQL
remaining: Provision the separate staging Supabase project
Configure backups and alerts
Complete and record a staging restore rehearsal

gates.title: Cloudflare R2 storage
remaining: Provision a private staging bucket
Run multipart, immutability, CORS, redaction, retention, deletion and audit exercises
Approve the optional redacted-video policy before enabling that release profile

gates.title: Cloud Run API and worker
remaining: Deploy staging with independent managed-secret versions
Verify autoscaling, alerts and rollback against live services

gates.title: Vercel web deployment
remaining: Create an independent staging project and configure the final custom production domain
Run browser security and cross-role authorization tests

gates.title: Windows collector release
remaining: Choose a signing identity and supported Windows versions
Build and sign on a trusted Windows runner
Record clean-machine permission, capture, recovery, upgrade, rollback and uninstall tests

gates.title: macOS collector release
remaining: Approve supported macOS versions and architecture strategy
Sign and notarize with an Apple Developer identity
Record physical permission, capture, recovery, upgrade, rollback and uninstall tests

gates.title: Linux collector release
remaining: Approve supported Ubuntu versions and package/update channel
Sign the package
Record Xorg acceptance and Wayland capability/fail-closed tests on clean machines

gates.title: End-to-end collection and release workflow
remaining: Repeat the workflow against staging OpenID, Supabase, R2, Cloud Run and Vercel
Attach reviewer/rework/release and independent-validator evidence

gates.title: Security, privacy, consent and operations
remaining: Assign security, privacy, legal, incident and support owners
Approve jurisdiction-specific notice, terms and retention periods
Run and record an incident exercise

gates.title: 100-trajectory staging soak
remaining: Collect at least 100 complete real staging trajectories
Verify no unexplained loss, state divergence, tenant leakage or invalid release
Record reliability, upload recovery, review and privacy metrics

gates.title: Controlled professional-contributor pilot
remaining: Complete every preceding production gate
Recruit consented pilot contributors across Windows, macOS and Linux
Run the go/no-go review using measured outcomes
